versionPairs.description: A real esbuild 0.28.2 `--bundle --minify --format=esm --platform=node` build of the shared node-app source (test/e2e/fixtures/node-app). esbuild 0.28 `--minify` as an ES module: the guarded helpers at the TOP LEVEL, a real top-level `import`. The vendor extraction works; the split does not read this layout (plugin-spec I25, the P9 bundle layout), so the run exits 0 with a WARNING and writes the named output unsplit. v1.1.0 perturbs the last dep (adds tripled), the late module's output and the lazy stamp.
